title: `get_tree().quit()` does not honor get_tree().auto_accept_quit = false and behaves differently to NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1-stable - 4.7.beta1

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta1 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9571) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9700K CPU @ 3.60GHz (8 threads) - 63.91 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

i need to delay the get_tree().quit() call because i need to await the graceful closure of a websocket connection.
the problem i see is that i have no _notification call that i can listen to. _exit_tree() is possible but somehow it isn't behaving the same as when listened to NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST with the same code and get_tree().auto_accept_quit = false.
get_tree().quit() seems to not honor the auto_accept_quit parameter and just closes at the end of the frame (which it's docs say). this now leaves me with two different closure behaviours depending on how the game get's closed.

my question is why there are two different ways of closing the game? shouldn't it be enough if get_tree().quit(0) calls NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST like pressing the windows x button or alt + f4? 

there is also the issue that prints() don't get printed into Output if they are done on the closing frame of get_tree().quit() but they are visible in the console if the console verion of the .exe is used.

### Steps to reproduce

oversimplified route 1:
* set get_tree().auto_accept_quit = false
* listen to NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST
* delay the request by a few frames with await get_tree().process_frame or awaiting a custom signal
* set get_tree().auto_accept_quit = true
* call get_tree().quit() as the initial closure request was interrupted with 1.
* game closes

 oversimplified route 2:
* set get_tree().auto_accept_quit = false
* make a button that calls get_tree().quit()
* delay the request by a few frames with await get_tree().process_frame or awaiting a custom signal (auto_accept_quit get's ignored and awaiting doesn't work)
* game closes

here is a commented MRP [bugtesting.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27226471/bugtesting.zip)
